description:
DECIDED 2026-09-06.

src/parser/lexer.rs:400 has fn, fnp, extern, defmacro, defmodule, defstruct,
defprotocol, defimpl. No def, no defp. The only def/defp anywhere in fixtures2 are
inside *.oracle.exs files -- real Elixir, hand-translated.

The oracle workflow means every fixture has a hand-written Elixir twin, so function
heads get retyped constantly and each retype is a chance to introduce a difference
the golden then blesses. Accepting def/defp makes the twin near-identical to the fz
source.

  "def"  => Tok::Fn
  "defp" => Tok::Fnp

Both spellings stay legal; existing code is untouched. Note  lambdas
are a separate production and are unaffected.

Update guides/modules.html:313, which currently documents fnp as the private form.

comments.text: Due-diligence correction before implementation: the proposed direct def -> Tok::Fn mapping would also admit def (x) -> ... end as an anonymous lambda because Tok::Fn is shared by named definitions and lambda expressions. That contradicts this ticket's note that lambdas are a separate, unaffected production. The implementation will use distinct Def/Defp tokens accepted only at named definition heads, then canonicalize them to the existing fn/fnp definition macros so downstream semantics remain single-owned.

Implemented as ddb0813b2. Added distinct Def/Defp lexer and quoted-token variants, accepted them only in named definition contexts, and canonicalized them to the existing fn/fnp definition macros; fn remains the sole anonymous-function marker. Updated fixture discovery for def main, added Elixir-oracled interp/JIT/AOT coverage, proved defp stays outside module interfaces, and updated parser/module/macro/quoted-source docs plus the modules guide. Green: cargo test --workspace --lib (2018 + 257 passed; 6 ignored), cargo test --workspace --doc, cargo test --test fz2_cli (30), cargo test --test aot_variadic_open (1), cargo test --test fixture_matrix (685), cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings, cargo fmt --check, and pre-commit gates.

title: Accept def/defp as aliases for fn/fnp
